name: Mrs. Grace Muthoni
bio: Mrs. Muthoni founded Gracious Love Academy in 2023 with over 12 years of distinguished leadership in early childhood and primary education. She believes every child excels when they are safe, loved, and known personally by name. She actively mentors teachers and engages directly with families.

name: Ms. Sarah Wanjiku
bio: Ms. Wanjiku brings warm, patient expertise in play-based learning and early literacy. She nurtures curiosity, phonics recognition, and foundational numeracy in a safe and joyful classroom where every child finds their voice.

name: Ms. Mary Wangari
bio: Ms. Wangari specializes in foundational literacy, practical math, and environmental studies. She is celebrated by parents for her patient dedication, detailed progress feedback, and ability to build reading confidence in every pupil.

name: Mrs. Faith Njeri
bio: Mrs. Njeri oversees curriculum delivery and prepares pupils for junior secondary with confidence, leadership projects, and self-directed study habits. She ensures students develop critical thinking and Christian moral values.
specialty: Upper Primary CBC & Junior Secondary Prep
